scientific_integrity: The theorem has an elementary analytic derivation and exact finite checks. No claims of independent verification, exhaustive historical priority, or uniformly controlled growing-category error.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive conditional profile among nondistinguished categories; stochastic incomparability only for n >= r+1; fixed-profile asymptotics, and residual historical priority risk; the finite raw covariance identity is implied by published occupancy-indicator covariance formulas.
title: One-switch distinguished-species dependence and its Poisson-scale boundary
